title: The Service of the Sons of Gershon and Merari in the Tabernacle
description: The Lord gave Moses instructions to register the sons of Gershon between thirty and fifty years old to carry the curtains, coverings, hangings, and cords of the tabernacle, and the sons of Merari to carry the planks, crossbars, pillars, and bases. Both clans were under the leadership of the priest Ithamar, son of Aaron.
